steps.name: Set schedule
steps.do: **Set Meet the Guardians talk schedule** with **Location**, **Talk name**, recurring **Talk times**, range including today (**Stops being offered on** as needed).

steps.name: Map talk visible
steps.do: On **Map**, set **Specific Map** to today. In **Filter:**, enable **Meet The Guardians Talks**.

steps.name: Itinerary lists talk
steps.do: Itinerary builder on today; Meet the Guardians step.

steps.name: Add occurrence
steps.do: **Add Meet the Guardians talk occurrence** for a date/time.

steps.name: Future clear
steps.do: Check a future date that was only covered by ended schedule.
steps.expect: Talks are cleared for dates after the end.
